verdicts.evidence: To the right of the headline and buttons, the hero is plain blue with nothing in it, roughly x 800–1280 by y 62–462 (about 480 × 400 px), and no product image is shown anywhere.
The main button reads only "Try it free", and nothing near the buttons gives a trial length, says whether a card is needed, or names a first step.

"Read-only access" with "The app can see balances and history but can never move money" is the third of three equal-weight feature columns, at the far right of the row under the hero, styled the same as "Shared budgets".
